Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Curious about what it’s like to work at Cognyte? 
 At Cognyte, you’ll collaborate with expert colleagues around the globe to solve problems most people will never even know exist!
 You’ll be part of building unique solutions shaped by real investigative methodologies, enabling our customers to identify, investigate, visualize and prevent criminal, terror and security threats worldwide.
 These solutions are used by law enforcement, national security, and national and military intelligence agencies in almost 100 countries to turn massive, diverse data into clear, actionable intelligence for a safer world.
 Looking for a hands-on Microsoft senior-expert with deep understanding of enterprise environments and strong ownership.
 The role involves managing and supporting Microsoft infrastructure and cloud services across multiple regions , with a focus on identity, endpoint management, collaboration tools, and automation.
 As a Cognyter you will: 
 Design and manage Active Directory (on‑prem & hybrid) across global environments
Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint) at scale
Manage Microsoft Intune (endpoint management, compliance, device lifecycle) 
Design and maintain SSO solutions (Azure AD / Entra ID integrations) 
Work with Azure services (identity, integrations, core infrastructure)
Maintain and troubleshoot DNS and core network services 
Lead and implement automation (Ansible, PowerShell) 
Ensure system security, availability, and performance globally
Drive improvements and best practices across systems and processes
Collaborate across international teams and stakeholders
 For that mission you'll need: 
 5+ years of experience , with strong hands-on expertise 
Proven experience as a Microsoft infrastructure expert 
Deep knowledge of:
Active Directory (on-prem & hybrid - design, replication, GPO strategy, hardening)
Microsoft Intune (compliance, configuration profiles, Autopilot)
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, identity, user lifecycle, mail flow, hybrid, security, anti-spam/phishing)
Azure / Entra ID (Conditional Access, Identity Protection, SSO, Hybrid identity, integrations)
DNS and networking fundamentals
Hybrid Identity (AD Connect / Cloud Sync, troubleshooting, design)
Hands-on experience with:
 Automation (Ansible, PowerShell) 
 SSO / identity integrations 
Very good English (spoken and written) 
Strong troubleshooting, ownership, and problem-solving mindset
 Nice to have: 
Microsoft certifications (Azure, M365, Intune / Endpoint Manager)
Experience working in global or enterprise environments 
Strong automation mindset
 Curious? Us too!
 We believe that diverse teams drive the greatness of ideas, products, and companies.
 Whatever your race, gender, age, creed, or taste in music – if you’re curious enough, you don’t need to check every box to apply.
 We’re waiting for you.
 Apply now.
